instructions.detail: Present the declared external display stimulus and keep it unchanged during the frequency measurement
Prepare the requested strip, then continue
Position the sample or measurement optics, then continue
Set up what the instrument asks for to calibrate, then continue
Do what the instrument asks for to calibrate; it continues by itself
Place the chart on the table
Sight a named fiducial so the table can locate the sheet
